generationInputs.prompt: A layered papercut diorama ebook cover for 'La Dieta de la Milpa' in warm and earthy tones, evoking tradition and health, crafted entirely from paper. The furthest plane features a subtly textured paper background in ocher and reddish-brown, like a vintage paper with a matte finish. The mid-ground showcases minimalist pre-Hispanic motifs representing corn and other milpa elements, meticulously cut from various shades of brown paper, creating a sense of depth through overlapping layers. Details such as stylized dry leaves and sun rays are incorporated as delicate paper cutouts in burnt orange and sunshine yellow, adding a touch of whimsy. The title 'La Dieta de la Milpa' is presented in an elegant and legible paper typeface, seemingly layered onto the foreground. A textured paper overlay, suggesting earth, grounds the composition, enhancing the artisanal and healthy feel. Subtle paper shading and layering create a sense of warmth, nostalgia, and authenticity within the paper diorama.
